name: Fixed-Horizon Thicket Maximum and Littlestone Maximality Are Incomparable
scope: At fixed positive horizon and Littlestone bound; the displayed reverse witness uses $(t,d)=(3,1)$.
statement: Attaining maximum thicket growth at one fixed horizon neither implies nor follows from inclusion-maximality at the same Littlestone dimension.
proof: $H_t$ attains the $(t,1)$ thicket bound but accepts an extra concept without raising Littlestone dimension. Conversely, $\{000,011,100\}$ is Littlestone-maximal of dimension one but has only three leaves at horizon three, below the bound four.
